EXCEPTIONS TO THE ABOVE:
1.	ADDITIONS TO KEYS MUST NOT USE ITEMS ADDED BY "DUCT" - PREPARE SEPARATELY, RELAYER AND EXPLODE TO PREVENT THE ROUTINE ATTEMPTING TO SCHEDULE THEM.

2.	ON SCHEMES WITH MAINLY EXISTING DUCTING, EXISTING "DUCT" LAYERS CAN BE BLOCKED OUT TO FORM A SEPARATE BASE THAT CAN BE EDITED MANUALLY AS FULL EDITING, NUMBERING, AND SCHEDULES WILL NOT BE REQUIRED FOR EXISTING ITEMS. PLEASE ASK FOR ADVICE IF YOU WISH TO DO THIS.
